articles.summary: ESS Tech, Inc. (NYSE: GWH) (“ESS” or the “Company”), a leading innovator in long-duration energy storage solutions, today announced that Randall “Randy” Selesky has joined the company as Chief Commercial Officer (CCO). In this role, Selesky will lead global commercial strategy, sales, marketing, product management, and business development initiatives as ESS advances commercialization and scales deployment of its long-duration energy storage solutions worldwide.
articles.title: ESS Appoints Randall Selesky as Chief Commercial Officer to Accelerate Global Growth
